name: Walk the ridge outskirts
desc: Two minutes up the old porters' path to the collapsed hut below Old Ridge. Hard ground draws on Strain; the climb teaches Composure. Someone who has settled the breath walks the ridge lightly: once you know the path, every outing draws a fifth less Strain.

events.text: Four bundles of notes survive in the collapsed porter's hut: one on carrying, one on the blade, one on reading ground, one on fixed layouts.

name: The porter's notes on carrying
desc: A body method for loads and slopes, and a technique to hold. Circulation can grow two levels further, and the carrying drills open; they want a porter's load frame on one span of your floor. The widow asks four bundles; a hollow reading of the slip already covers the first pages, so three if you settle the breath.

name: The porter's notes on the blade
desc: A guard's method for meeting what comes up the path, and a technique to hold. Blade Intent opens, and with it the blade-contact drills; they want a practice post on one span of your floor. The widow asks four bundles.

name: The porter's notes on ground
desc: How a surveyor tells settled ground from sliding ground, and a technique to hold. Ground Reading opens, and with it the ground drills; they want survey stakes on one span of your floor. The widow asks four bundles; a channel reading of the slip has already taught the hand half of it, so three if you carry the current.

name: The porter's notes on layouts
desc: Fixed layouts that steady a small area, and a technique to hold. Array Craft opens, and with it the array drills; they want a drawing board on one span of your floor. The widow asks four bundles.

name: Blade Intent
desc: Meeting a blade's line with your own. From level 2 the carved face gives a measure more grit with every cut.

events.text: The post stops ringing when you meet it. On the carved face your edge finds the soft seams first, and a measure more of grit comes away with every cut.

name: Ground Reading
desc: Where the ground holds and where it slides. From level 2 the stable point gives a piece more ore each time.

events.text: Poured water runs where you guessed it would, three times running. Above the slide you start to see the ore before your foot finds it.

name: Array Craft
desc: Small fixed layouts that hold a place still. From level 2 a tested layout keeps a token more each time.

events.text: A layout on your floor holds through a whole night with nobody correcting it. On the ridge the next test keeps a token more.

name: Sink the breath under the load
desc: The porter's way of climbing on: qi sunk below the navel and down into the legs. Three qi bring back two Strain. Held, it adds two to Life and one to Guard in a fight.
flavor: His widow says he climbed the ridge twice a day until he was seventy.

name: Cut by intent
desc: The guard's trick of letting the intent arrive before the blade. Three qi through the edge take two measures of whetstone grit off worked stone in one stroke. Held, it adds one to Strike and five to Hit in a fight.
flavor: The notes say a good guard cuts the rope before the bridge sways.

name: Read the grain
desc: The surveyor's habit of listening before digging. Three qi spent listening find two pieces of veined ore where the ground's grain gathers it. Held, ore pried by hand comes away a piece richer, and you carry two more Strain.
flavor: Ground that has slid once remembers which way it went.

name: Fix a layout
desc: Three qi pressed into a tested layout fix its marks, and two tokens keep them without ink. Held, a small layout keeps your floor still: Rest and the slip's breath practice both run a quarter faster.
flavor: Nothing moves inside it that you did not put there.

name: Porter's load frame
desc: One span of floor. Carrying drills run a quarter faster against a loaded frame.

name: Practice post
desc: One span of floor. Blade-contact drills run a quarter faster against a post that answers.

name: Survey stakes and cord
desc: One span of floor laid out as a model slope with three lengths of timber for stakes. Ground drills run a quarter faster.

name: Drawing board
desc: One span of floor and four bundles boiled down to herb ink for marking layouts. Array drills run a quarter faster.

name: Carry and recover
desc: Loaded climbs on the frame, then the breath that brings the body back. Circulation grows at three experience per second, with a little Labour; it draws lightly on Strain. After two minutes of it, the survey marker gives a root more each haul.
needtext: A load frame on the floor, and room left in Circulation.

events.text: The frame stops feeling like a load and starts feeling like a shape you hold. Hauling the marker, you have breath left over to dig a root more around it.

name: Blade-contact drills
desc: Meet the post, hold, release. Blade Intent grows at three experience per second.
needtext: A practice post on the floor, and room left in Blade Intent.

name: Compare stones and currents
desc: Stake, pour, watch where it runs. Ground Reading grows at three experience per second, with a little Stone Sense.
needtext: Survey stakes on the floor, and room left in Ground Reading.

name: Steady the observation area
desc: Set the tokens, sit within them, correct what drifts. Array Craft grows at three experience per second, with a little Composure.
needtext: A drawing board on the floor, and room left in Array Craft.

name: Recover the survey marker
desc: A minute and a half hauling the fallen marker back onto its footing. Two marrow herbs grow in the disturbed ground each time; the first haul lets Circulation reach one level further, and opens the ground to digging by hand.

name: Dig marrow herbs by the marker
desc: Bitter roots from the ground the marker disturbed, dug by hand. Three Vigor a root.

name: Expose the inscription
desc: A minute and a half cutting moss from a carved face. Two measures of whetstone grit each time; the first cut lets Blade Intent reach one level further, and leaves the face open to scraping by hand.

name: Scrape grit from the inscription
desc: Fine grit worked off the carved face with a blade's edge. Three Vigor a measure.

name: Find the stable observation point
desc: A minute and a half testing footholds above the slide. Two pieces of veined ore each time; the first find lets Ground Reading reach one level further, and shows where to pry ore by hand.

name: Pry ore above the slide
desc: Ore worked loose from the footholds the stable point showed you. Three Vigor a piece.

name: Test a fixed layout
desc: A minute and a half holding a layout against the ridge wind. Two inked tokens keep their marks each time; the first test lets Array Craft reach one level further, and shows how to ink tokens by hand.

name: Ink tokens for the layout
desc: Tokens marked by hand from the tested layout. Three Vigor a token.

name: First Direction: the Body
desc: Three minutes under the loaded frame with the reconstructed method. The bill is paid at the start, and paying it closes the other three directions. Afterwards the bank keeps up to a day of time away.

breakthrough.title: First Direction: the Body
breakthrough.coreLabel: Circulation 4, and the carrying drills begun

pointers.label: A furnished home: a cot, a herb plot or a strongbox
Two methods of the body school used: Steady the breath, Settle the breath or Sink the breath under the load
Two hundred coin earned in wages

warn: Paying for the Body makes it your First Direction. The Sword, the Earth and Formation close for good, and whatever you have spent on them stays spent.

events.text: The load settles into the frame of the body itself. Body Disciple. The main approach no longer looks steep.

name: First Direction: the Sword
desc: Three minutes at the post with the reconstructed method. The bill is paid at the start, and paying it closes the other three directions. Afterwards the bank keeps up to a day of time away.

breakthrough.title: First Direction: the Sword
breakthrough.coreLabel: Blade Intent 4, and the blade-contact drills begun

pointers.label: A furnished home: a cot, a herb plot or a strongbox
A method of the sword school used: Cut by intent
Two hundred coin earned in wages

warn: Paying for the Sword makes it your First Direction. The Body, the Earth and Formation close for good, and whatever you have spent on them stays spent.

events.text: The post stops answering; the intent arrives before the blade. Sword Disciple. The side passage looks cuttable.

name: First Direction: the Earth
desc: Three minutes kneeling on the stakes with the reconstructed method. The bill is paid at the start, and paying it closes the other three directions. Afterwards the bank keeps up to a day of time away.

breakthrough.title: First Direction: the Earth
breakthrough.coreLabel: Ground Reading 4, and the ground drills begun

pointers.label: A furnished home: a cot, a herb plot or a strongbox
A method of the earth school used: Carry the current or Read the grain
Two hundred coin earned in wages

warn: Paying for the Earth makes it your First Direction. The Body, the Sword and Formation close for good, and whatever you have spent on them stays spent.

events.text: Under the knees the ground has a grain, and the grain has a direction. Earth Listener. A stable line runs up the ridge.

name: First Direction: Formation
desc: Three minutes inside a held layout with the reconstructed method. The bill is paid at the start, and paying it closes the other three directions. Afterwards the bank keeps up to a day of time away.

breakthrough.title: First Direction: Formation
breakthrough.coreLabel: Array Craft 4, and the array drills begun

pointers.label: A furnished home: a cot, a herb plot or a strongbox
A method of the formation school used: Fix a layout
Two hundred coin earned in wages

warn: Paying for Formation makes it your First Direction. The Body, the Sword and the Earth close for good, and whatever you have spent on them stays spent.

events.text: The tokens stop drifting and the air inside them stops too. Formation Student. A small array could turn the flow on the ridge.

name: Body Disciple
title: Body Disciple
desc: The First Direction of the Body: loads and slopes are met by the frame of the body. Strike, Guard, Speed and Dodge rise, and every level of Labour adds another point of Vigor.

name: Sword Disciple
title: Sword Disciple
desc: The First Direction of the Sword: intent arrives before the blade. Strike, Guard, Speed and Hit rise, and timber comes away clean: a length more every trip beyond the mill.

name: Earth Listener
title: Earth Listener
desc: The First Direction of the Earth: the ground's grain can be followed. You keep to ground that holds, so Strain drains a quarter slower everywhere; you carry two more Strain, and every level of Stone Sense adds another.

name: Formation Student
title: Formation Student
desc: The First Direction of Formation: a held layout steadies a small place. Your floor holds a span more, and what already stands on it works harder: the pallet and the cot rest you faster, the mat speeds the breath practice, and the herb plot grows more.

name: Reinforced ascent of the main approach
desc: A minute and a half straight up the broken main approach with a full load. It draws on Strain as fast as Strain returns. A carried current takes you up half again as fast.

events.text: You reach the top with the load still on your back and set it down inside the waystation's door. The service passage opens with a shoulder; the way back is ordinary now.

name: Cut open the side passage
desc: A minute and a half cutting through the thorn and deadfall that close the side passage. It draws on Strain as fast as Strain returns. A carried current takes you through half again as fast.

events.text: The last of the thorn falls away and the side passage lets you into the waystation yard. The keeper looks at the cut ends for a long moment, then at you.

name: Follow the stable line
desc: A minute and a half along the one line of ground that does not slide. It draws on Strain as fast as Strain returns. A carried current takes you along it half again as fast.

events.text: The stable line runs out at the waystation's footings, which were laid square on it. Whoever built the place could hear the ground too.

name: Divert the flow with a small array
desc: A minute and a half setting tokens until the runoff turns aside from the path. It draws on Strain as fast as Strain returns. A carried current sets them half again as fast.

events.text: The runoff turns along your tokens and leaves the path dry to the waystation gate. The keeper asks you to leave the tokens where they are.

name: The ridge waystation
desc: The old porters' waystation on Old Ridge, reached by your own direction.

name: Work the waystation stores
desc: Three vigor for eight coin and a little Labour, shifting stores for the keeper. He pays two coin more a load after ten loads and again after thirty. Taking this job closes the ferry hauling.

name: Trade marrow herbs
desc: The waystation keeper pays ten coin for three marrow herbs.

name: Trade whetstone grit
desc: The waystation keeper pays ten coin for three measures of whetstone grit.

name: Trade veined ore
desc: The waystation keeper pays ten coin for three pieces of veined ore.

name: Trade inked tokens
desc: The waystation keeper pays ten coin for three inked tokens.

name: Surviving route records toward the Cloudwell basin
desc: The keeper's ledgers name a basin beyond the ridge.

name: An unusual chime
desc: At dusk something rings once from higher up the ridge.

name: The damaged spur
desc: A spur of the old path ends at a slide.

name: The slip's other nine leaves
desc: The keeper's oldest ledger lists a jade slip of twelve leaves, carried up the porters' path to be sold in the Cloudwell basin long before Shu was born. Three of its leaves stayed below.

name: Face the man on the porters' path
desc: A minute on the path with a man who wants your herbs. He is harder than Tam: ten of life, a strike of eight, a guard of five, and heavy-handed; if he still stands when the minute is out, he has outlasted you. Losing costs the Vigor and herbs you brought; winning clears the path to whatever he keeps. Once begun it cannot stop, so it waits for enough Strain to see the minute through. Nothing here is needed to cross, and the earth and formation teachings find his cache without meeting him.

encounter.failureText: you back off along the path, and the herbs are gone. A blow that does not get past his guard of five does nothing; Circulation and the methods you hold are what raise your Strike.

events.text: The man on the path goes down and stays down long enough to think better of it. When you look round he is a shape on the far slope, and the path is quiet for the first time in a season.

name: The porters' path is clear
desc: The man on the path has gone. Whatever he kept is still up there.

name: Read the path for his cache
desc: Ninety seconds reading the ground along the porters' path. Stone that has been lifted and put back lies wrong, and the wrong stones lead to his cache without your meeting him. Teaches Ground Reading.
flavor: He hides things the way a man does who has never been asked where the ground is soft.

name: Mark out the path for his cache
desc: Ninety seconds laying tokens along the porters' path and watching which ones he steps round. The shape he keeps clear of points at his cache without your meeting him. Teaches Array Craft.
flavor: A man who walks the same path every day has drawn a map of it with his feet.

name: His cache is found
desc: You know where the man on the path keeps what he takes, and he does not know you know.

name: Search the man's cache
desc: Two minutes searching a hollow under the path. Four of each ridge material your teachings put to use; the line sites give the same.

name: Iron-bound coffer
desc: Room for two hundred more coin; enough to save for a cottage.

name: A cottage beyond the mill
desc: Eight spans of floor, a place to sleep, a place to practise and a place to study. The walls hold a little qi of their own. Arrangements move with you; the Lean-to closes when you move.

events.text: Wen helps carry your things across and stays longer than he needs to, one hand flat on the wall. ‘Warm for the season,’ he says, and does not ask why.

name: Reading desk
desc: Fills the place you study. Copying the slip goes half again as fast, and Lore can reach one level further.
